description: This file defines the DeleteCodeCommandHandler class, which handles commands to delete codes within the Fineract infrastructure. It processes a delete command by invoking the underlying CodeWritePlatformService.

classes.name: DeleteCodeCommandHandler
classes.description: Handler for processing delete code commands, uses the CodeWritePlatformService to perform the deletion within a transactional context.

methods.name: DeleteCodeCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the CodeWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the delete command by calling deleteCode on the service with the specified entity ID.
